title: PACE%2BCode%2BD%2B2023.pdf — section 97
text:
7. A group identification need not be held if the identification officer believes, because of the
unusual appearance of the suspect, none of the locations it would be practicable to use,
satisfy the requirements of paragraph 6 necessary to make the identification fai r.

8. Immediately after a group identification procedure has taken place (with or without the
suspect’s consent), a colour photograph or video should be taken of the general scene, if
practicable, to give a general impression of the scene and the number of people present.
Alternatively, if it is practicable, the group identification may be video recorded.

9. If it is not practicable to take the photograph or video in accordance with paragraph 8, a
photograph or film of the scene should be taken later at a time determined by the
identification officer if the officer considers it practicable to do so.
